snippets.description: Additive-only migration: create_table('agent_fetch_events') + 2 indexes; down_revision='b3f9a1d2c7e5' (single head re-confirmed at EXECUTE via `python -m alembic heads`); reversible downgrade drops indexes then table. Zero changes to any existing table.
New AgentFetchEvent(Base) — id/created_at/updated_at from Base; no ORM ForeignKey on site_id (house convention). Structurally separate from Visitor/Event.

One additive fail-open call inside the existing agent branch (gated by agent_detection_enabled + classification is not None), after persist_agent_visit and before the 204 return. No new synchronous external call.
snippets.content: tier = classify_tier(classification.product_or_ua_token); await persist_agent_fetch_event(db, batch.site_id, classification, tier, ip_address, agent_path)
